pages.title: About
pages.description: A small team building premium AI finance tools for modern spenders.

hero.headline: A smarter way to see your money story.
hero.text: We built TrackTok to make finance feel less confusing and more empowering — with premium design and AI intelligence at the center.

sections.title: Our story
content: TrackTok started because finance apps felt clunky, noisy, and confusing.
We wanted a dashboard that felt calm, smart, and worthy of the premium finance insights it delivers.
Our mission is to give people clarity on their cash without adding another chore to their day.
